scope: Actual compiled generator and actual Rhino 1.7.15 plus Swing EDT; headless contract checks, not a real IDE or original CI reproduction
sourceBinding: corrected/source-binding.json confirms independently javac-compiled preserved source returns byte-identical script to the Gradle class
adaptation: Unmodified script used for EDT JSON String and non-EDT rejection. Tree cases replace only var windows=java.awt.Window.getWindows(); with var windows=roots;. Injected RootPanel overrides isShowing=true; descendants are actual Swing components with real bounds and visibleRect calculations. No fake IDE or owner class was introduced.
discoveredAndFixed: Old class omitted nodes after count reached 6000 while reporting truncated=false; actual 6001-node run reproduced it. Root corrected truncation, final run reports nodes6000/children5999/truncated=true. Old class/script/failing report retained; old source snapshot was already corrected and explicitly marked not bound to that old class.

reflectionReview.method: Read-only review of generated JS, source and javap of actual compiled owner/registry/conversation classes
reflectionReview.fieldAbsenceHandling: scalar fields catch errors as field:<name>; conversation fields/session calls catch as conversation-session; card ids/settlements catch as approval-state; captured listener field access catches as listener-owner. No setters, button action calls, approval state transitions or retries are added.
reflectionReview.runtimeErrorCase: Actual script with a Swing Send button whose listener accessor throws returns an errors entry and leaves text/bounds unchanged. This tests the inspection error boundary, not live IDE owner reflection.
reflectionReview.limitation: No actual ConversationView instance was instantiated or discovered inside a real IDEA Window. Runtime classloader/accessibility and owner discovery remain real-host evidence requirements; ownerCount=0 is not proof of a conversation capture.

restrictions: No tracked source changes, Gradle invocation, GUI launch, Git action or retry added by this review.
